text: かっかざんは　せかいに　１５００　いじょう　あるというな　かんがえた　だけで　あついぜ！

structure.jp: かっかざんは　せかいに
１５００　いじょう　あるというな
structure.en: they say there are more than 1,500

structure.jp: かんがえた　だけで

patterns.name: 〜という (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: という at the end of a statement means 'they say' or 'I hear that', for something you learned from others. あるというな = 'they say there are, don't they'.

patterns.name: 〜だけで
patterns.span: かんがえた　だけで
patterns.explanation: A past verb followed by だけで means 'just by doing that, nothing more'. かんがえた　だけで = 'just by thinking about it'.
